using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Cluster.Tests
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<MigrateOperation> _mockMigrateOperation;

        public MigrateSessionTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>>();
            _mockMigrateOperation = new Mock<MigrateOperation>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_SuccessfulSetSlotRange_LogsTraceCompletionMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>(); // Assuming interface or using refactor if needed
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Returns(mockClient.Object.WaitAsync(It.IsAny<TimeSpan>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                      .ReturnsAsync("OK");

            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);
            // Setup session properties needed for the call
            session._sslots = new List<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
            session._slotRanges = new List<SlotRange> { new SlotRange(1, 3) };
            session._timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("targetNode", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT") && v.ToString().Contains("1-3") && v.ToString().Contains("STABLE")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_NonOkResult_LogsErrorAndDoesNotLogCompletionTrace()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            mockClient.SetupSequence(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .Returns(mockClient.Object.WaitAsync(It.IsAny<TimeSpan>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                      .ReturnsAsync("ERROR");

            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);
            session._sslots = new List<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
            session._slotRanges = new List<SlotRange> { new SlotRange(1, 3) };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("targetNode", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.Log(LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.Log(LogLevel.Trace, It.Is<EventId>(e => e.Name == "[Completed] SETSLOT"), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_OperationCanceledException_LogsTimeoutError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .ThrowsAsync(new OperationCanceledException());

            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);
            session._sslots = new List<int> { 4, 5, 6 };
            session._timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(5000);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync(null, MigrateState.NODE);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny<EventId>(), 
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("timed out") && v.ToString().Contains("5000") && v.ToString().Contains("4-6")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_GeneralException_LogsErrorWithException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            var testException = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .ThrowsAsync(testException);

            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);
            session._sslots = new List<int> { 10, 11 };

            // Act

            // Assert

                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(),
                    testException,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TryRecoverFromFailureAsync_FailedSetSlotRanges_LogsRecoveryError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), null, It.IsAny<List<SlotRange>>()))
                      .ThrowsAsync(new OperationCanceledException());

            _mockMigrateOperation.Setup(op => op.Client).Returns(mockClient.Object);
            
            var session = CreateMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object, _mockMigrateOperation.Object);
            session._sslots = new List<int> { 100, 101 };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TryRecoverFromFailureAsync();

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("failed to make slots STABLE")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private MigrateSession CreateMigrateSession(ILogger<MigrateSession> logger, MigrateOperation migrateOperation)
        {
            // This would need to be implemented based on the actual constructor

            throw new NotImplementedException("Requires actual MigrateSession constructor or refactor");
        }
    }
